name: Soul Harvest
description: The Soulbinder opens a rift that drinks the souls of every foe caught in it.

effects.text: The rift tears at every soul in range.
The harvested souls rot from within.
A fraction of the harvest returns to the Soulbinder.

runes.name: Reaper
runes.description: The rift is opened wider and deeper, drinking every soul it can reach.

runes.name: Grave Harvest
runes.description: The rift stays open over a broad stretch of ground, but harvests less at once.

runes.name: Echo of the Harvest
runes.description: The harvested souls keep screaming long after the rift closes.

name: Shadow Wisp
description: The Soulbinder tears two wisps of shadow from the grave to fight for her.

effects.text: Two shadow wisps rise to fight at the Soulbinder's side.
The summoning draws a little Souls back.

runes.name: Swarm of Wisps
runes.description: Three wisps claw out of the grave instead of two.

runes.name: Binding Rite
runes.description: A cheaper rite that also feeds the Soulbinder's well of Souls.

name: Life Drain
description: The Soulbinder drinks the life out of a single foe and takes it for herself.

effects.text: The drain siphons the target's life away.
The stolen life mends the Soulbinder.

runes.name: Deep Siphon
runes.description: The drain pulls harder and mends the Soulbinder faster.

runes.name: Withering Touch
runes.description: A gentler drain that steals less life but takes only a moment to cast.

name: Cursed Bolt
description: A bolt of cursed shadow that buries itself in the target's flesh.

effects.text: The curse rots the wound from within.

runes.name: Hex
runes.description: A heavier bolt that hits harder and asks more of the Soulbinder's well.

runes.name: Rotting Hex
runes.description: The curse inside the wound never stops eating.

name: Grave Call
description: The Soulbinder calls the grave itself up over a wide stretch of the pit.

effects.text: The grave tears at every foe in the ground.
The called dead rot the living.
Cursed foes lose the strength to build their resource.

runes.name: Nether Grave
runes.description: The grave opens far wider and takes a much longer to close again.

runes.name: Deep Curse
runes.description: The curse laid on the dead takes hold and never lifts.
